race.title: Winter Family Raceday 29th December Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: A small field but it looks competitive with 3 progressive last-time-out winners, NAZARE shading the vote over Fairlawn Skipper and Palamon . NAZARE (FR) FAIRLAWN SKIPPER PALAMON (IRE)
